comment: SC-001: the six audit acceptance checks and the automated tests that carry them. Check n is carried by TestProfilesV3Acceptance_Check<n>_* (internal/server) plus the cross-surface tests listed. Test refs use the parity-matrix grammar: go:<repo path>#<Test>, vitest:<repo path>, xctest:<repo path>#<method>, pw:<repo path>. TestProfilesV3AcceptanceIndexResolves resolves every ref and fails when a TestProfilesV3Acceptance_Check* function is missing from this index.

checks.title: A read-only profile hides every non-read, denied, unclassified and out-of-scope tool from discovery
A write call is refused before any upstream I/O, recorded as blocked with attribution, and the record is listed by client and status on REST, CLI, Web UI and macOS
An unannotated tool stays hidden until classified, then is visible and callable within one request
Reassigning a client takes effect on its next request without touching its credential, and its live session is told its tool list changed
A locked client cannot switch profile and the management tool is for administrators only
Web UI deep links /tools?client=, /usage?profile= and /sessions?client= load filtered, show a removable chip and keep it across navigation and Back
